title: Libeara Agrees to Acquire Zodia Markets' Jersey Entity
why_it_matters: The transaction would give Libeara a regulated Jersey operating entity, extending the institutional footprint behind its tokenized-asset infrastructure beyond its Singapore-licensed business.
caption:
RWA WIRE // INSTITUTIONS

Libeara Agrees to Acquire Zodia Markets' Jersey Entity

Libeara has signed an agreement to buy Zodia Markets' regulated Jersey entity, subject to approval, adding a potential European base for its tokenization business.
